messages:
Ava (Marketing): Quick ask — need a compact benchmark tile set (3 sizes) for the 'Serving Wins' webinar. Main stats: 2x p95 latency improvement, ~40% lower per-token cost, 99.9% SLA. Can we reuse the micro-hero template and produce a one-pager for sales?
Sam (Design): Got it. Which visual system variant? Minimal iconography or strong illustrated approach?
Ava (Marketing): Keep it minimal. Key elements: comparison sparkline, cost-per-token callout, small methods footnote. Need dark and light variants.
Priya (Growth): Also need a 1:1 social card and a 16:9 webinar hero slide. CTA variants: Register / Request demo / Watch on-demand.
Sam (Design): ETA? I can mock 3 tiles + slide if scope is firm.
Tomas (Prod PM): Can you attach the benchmark numbers and final microcopy? We prefer not to iterate after design.
Ava (Marketing): Data snapshot: p95 measured on production chat workload; baseline = open-serve v2. Copy suggestions: header: '2x faster p95 latency†' body: 'Reduces per-token cost by ~40% on typical sequences' footnote: '†p95 measured on web-chat workload; see methods link.'
Sam (Design): Legal/brand flags? Accessibility requirements?
Ava (Marketing): Legal cleared the claims if we include the footnote + methods link. Accessibility: aim for 4.5:1 contrast for text; large numeric callouts may use brand teal.
Miguel (Brand): Brand note — avoid orange as primary accent here. Use Teal 700 for callouts, Neutral 100/900 backgrounds. Include official icon set only (no new illustrations).
Sam (Design): Roger. I'll spin Figma file with color tokens & export specs.
FigmaBot: New file created by Sam: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd-1755000000/bench-tiles-sales-cheat (permissions: marketing-team view)
Priya (Growth): Also: lead routing requirements — utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=serving-wins and hidden form field 'workload_type' with values {"chat", "embedding"}. Sales wants a PDF cheat-sheet with talking points.
Ava (Marketing): We'll hand off tracking to ops, but include a short sales one-pager in the asset pack.
Sam (Design): I'll add a 1-page 'sales cheat' template in the same Figma, with export-ready PDF.
Ava (Marketing): Timeline: copy lock Wed EOD, design final Fri AM, exports by Fri noon so growth can schedule channels over the weekend.
Sam (Design): Friday AM exports are tight but doable if copy is locked by Wednesday. Please drop final copy and legal link here.
Ava (Marketing): Final copy paste: 'Serving wins: 2x faster p95 latency, ~40% lower per-token cost — Redwood Inference.' Methods link: https://redwood.inference/benchmarks/methods
Ava (Marketing): Sales cheat bullets: 1) test context (web-chat, 8–16 tokens prompt), 2) baseline device, 3) cost math example (per 1k tokens), 4) objection handling lines.
Sam (Design): Uploading initial previews. Light variant: https://redwood.ai/s3/preview/bench-light-1755000000.png Dark variant: https://redwood.ai/s3/preview/bench-dark-1755000000.png Slide mock: https://redwood.ai/s3/preview/bench-slide-1755000000.png
Priya (Growth): Prepping UTMs and tracking snippet. Will confirm form field names by Thu.
Miguel (Brand): Quick checklist for final export: SVG icons, color tokens included in file, ensure kerning for numeric callouts, export PNG at 2x for social.
Sam (Design): On it. I'll add accessible color swatches and alt copy text in the handoff notes.
Ava (Marketing): :thumbsup: Thank you. Sam — when you upload final assets, add a small README with routing instructions and the legal footnote text.
Sam (Design): Will do. Expect final package upload Fri 11:30am PT.
Ava (Marketing): Awesome. Priya, Tomas — I'll DM you the lead-routing JSON for integrating into the registration form.
Priya (Growth): Thanks — I'll validate with analytics once I get it.
Tomas (Prod PM): I'll coordinate with the frontend for tracking fields.
Ava (Marketing): Closing notes: keep the tile copy tight, avoid hype language, keep metrics precise. I'll reconvene if legal requests changes. Thanks team!
